headline.text: L1 S2 jar line held *11 pallets* on label failures; L3 truffle belt missing nuts and bolts flagged as foreign material risk.

summary: One active quality hold at L1 S2 — 11 pallets awaiting disposition after labeler could not apply labels consistently. L3 truffle line crossover belt discovered missing hardware; maintenance notified. Four pieces of L1 S3 equipment failed allergen tests during cleaning verification and are being re-cleaned.

holds.title: 11 pallets rework — label application failures on S2 jar line
holds.summary: Labeler produced bubbles and wrinkles throughout 2nd and 3rd shifts, eventually unable to apply labels consistently; 11 pallets went through sealing and X-ray but are held for label rework.
holds.status: On hold pending QA disposition; line completed level 2 clean and staged for Monday.

food_safety.title: Truffle line crossover belt missing nuts and bolts
food_safety.summary: Small belt that crosses sideways discovered missing nuts and bolts on one side during 3rd shift cleaning; potential for hardware to fall into product zone.
food_safety.status: Open — maintenance notified at 07:16 MT, no resolution posted by window close.

quality.title: S2 jar labeler reliability — bubbles, wrinkles, skipped jars
quality.summary: Labeler A produced defective labels (bubbles, wrinkles) starting 2nd shift; crew switched to Labeler B which also could not keep pace, skipping jars intermittently.
quality.status: Resolved on shift — crew switched to Labeler B and made WIP; 11 pallets held for rework.

sanitation.title: S3 allergen test failures — C19, C20, C26, Zbelt
sanitation.summary: Four pieces of equipment failed allergen verification tests during cleaning; crew initiated re-clean.
sanitation.status: Being re-cleaned; retest results not posted by window close.

opportunities.text: Consider adding labeler pre-shift function checks and daily preventive maintenance window — S2 labeler failures today resulted in 11 pallets on hold and ~3 hours of line disruption across both labelers.
Consider adding hardware inspection (nuts, bolts, fasteners) to belt reassembly checklist — truffle line crossover belt found missing hardware after cleaning, creating foreign material risk.
Review depositor assembly and gasket/O-ring replacement procedures — ML4 Depositor 3 leak traced to missing O-ring that maintenance replaced today.
